name: STAR Geodesy — WGS-84 ellipsoid: radii of curvature, auxiliary latitudes, meridian arc
summary: Radii of curvature, geocentric radius, geocentric / parametric / rectifying latitude and meridian arc on WGS-84 at a geodetic latitude; agrees with pymap3d and PyGeodesy to rounding (arc within 4e-9 m) and refuses latitudes outside [-90, 90].
reference_observed: b, e^2, polar radius of curvature and meridian quadrant reproduced to the printed digits

review.G-04: geodetic latitude in degrees in; metres and degrees out; WGS-84 constants pinned in the tests
review.G-06: no external data; cross-check corpus generated with a fixed seed
